title: Keep related data
summary: Kotlin: Keep related data. Print the original book.pages too.
introduction: A data class stores fields and supplies useful data operations such as copy.

blocks.text: Install a JDK and Kotlin. Save lesson.kt, run kotlinc lesson.kt -include-runtime -d lesson.jar, then java -jar lesson.jar.

blocks.title: Keep related data

blocks.text: copy keeps title and makes a new record with 30 pages. The old record is unchanged.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: copy makes a new value; it does not change the original.
